newsitem.title: UK: Prudential leads UK insurance stocks higher.
newsitem.headline: Prudential leads UK insurance stocks higher.

text.p: British insurance shares forged ahead on Monday as bid speclation and a recent positive note by analysts at BZW continued to drive them upwards, dealers said.

BZW insurance analysts Angus Runciman and Michael Huttner said they had issued a positive assessment on Friday of Prudential's offer for Scottish Amicable, which repeated a "buy" recommendation on Commercial Union Plc, General Accident Plc and Prudential.
Prudential shares were up 14p at 586 by 1116 GMT while Commercial Union was up 16p at 752-1/2 and General Accident rose 19-1/2p to 865-1/2.
Legal and General Group Plc gained five pence to 403-1/2 and Guardian Royal Exchange rose two pence to 295.
"The bid underlined value in the rest of the sector," Runciman said.
Dealers said bid speculation swirling around the sector was also driving share prices up.
"Nobody wants to be short at the moment," one market-maker said.
